[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 17 ([[Translated#Dialogue|Translated Hardcore]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Breaker2''' is an enemy that appears in [[Easy Mode|Easy]], [[Casual Mode|Casual]], [[Intermediate Mode|Intermediate]], [[Molten Mode|Molten]], [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]], [[Challenge Trials]], [[Pizza Party]], [[Badlands II]] and [[PVP]] modes. While it appears in all [[PVP]] ranks, it can only be sent by a player in Basic Arena [[PVP]]. It has a decent amount of health and a slightly fast speed, being slightly faster than the [[Hidden]]. Upon death, it will spawn one [[Breaker]], which has less health but is faster. The [[Breaker]], when spawned, is temporarily invulnerable to all forms of damage. Because of this, the '''Breaker2''' can easily overwhelm unprepared players. The '''Breaker2''' is spawned by the [[Breaker3]] upon its death, and is temporarily invulnerable to all forms of damage. The [[Grave Digger]] (both the regular and [[Grave Digger (Legacy)|legacy]] version) also has a chance to spawn the '''Breaker2''' with its ''Triumphing Sheol'' ability on [[Easy Mode|Easy]] mode, as well as on [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode if the [[Enemies Beta]] modifier is active. It can/could also be spawned by the [[Mystery Summoner]], [[Summoner Boss]], [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode's [[Necromancer Boss]] and [[Void Reaver (Legacy)|Void Reaver]] if the [[Enemies Beta]] modifier is active. The '''Breaker2''' also appeared as part of the [[The Classic Event]], [[Tower Defense Simulator x PLS DONATE Event]] and [[The Takeover Event]]. The '''Breaker2''' was replaced by the [[Png Bot2]] in [[Headache Headquarters]]. The '''Breaker2''' replaces the [[Mystery]] in any map with the [[Enemies Beta]] modifier active. ==Appearance== {{Tabber |Modern |The '''Breaker2''' is a humanoid with a dark green torso and legs that have a square pattern design of varying sizes and shades of green. Its arms and head are made out of light green construction paper, with the front and back faces of each part being separate halves held together by small strips of tape. It has a small blue humanoid on its chest that represents the [[Breaker]]. If spawned from the [[Breaker3]], the '''Breaker2''' jumps up with its left arm pointed upwards before falling to the ground. It plays a squeaking sound and emits small waves and green confetti particles on death. |Legacy |The legacy '''Breaker2''' has a pastel light green skin color. It has a pale green torso and legs with a plaid stitch mark pattern on them. It has a dark cyan humanoid on its chest, representing the [[Breaker]]. It plays a crumbling sound on death. }} ==Strategy== *The '''Breaker2''' can prove to be quite dangerous due to its high health, speed and its ability to spawn a [[Breaker]]. **Fairly cheap high DPS towers like the [[Minigunner]] or [[Golden Crook Boss]] are very useful. **Strong early game towers like the [[Golden Scout]], [[Ace Pilot]], [[Assassin]] or [[Militant]] are effective, though weaker ones like the [[Scout]] or [[Soldier]] may falter. ***Setting your towers to ''Strongest'' targeting can help against '''Breaker2s''' as it avoids the [[Breaker]]'s invincibility frames. **As these spawn in hordes, area of effect towers like the [[Demoman]], [[Assassin]], [[Pyromancer]] or the [[Shotgunner]] can be quite useful against them. *Later on in the game, natural '''Breaker2''' spawns are not as threatening, though it can be dangerous because of the [[Breaker4]]. **Stronger area of effect towers, like the [[Electroshocker]], [[Golden Pyromancer]], [[Rocketeer]] or [[Mortar]] are effective against all forms of breakers. *Be aware that you do not earn any cash from damaging the [[Breaker]] that the '''Breaker2''' spawns in every mode. *The [[Breaker]] that spawns from the '''Breaker2''' does not need to be killed for wave progression to occur. *The [[Frost Blaster]], [[Freezer]] and [[Electroshocker]] can be quite efficient at slowing these down while also dealing decent damage to them. ==Sounds== {{Sounds|{{pe| {| class{{=}}"article-table align-center" style{{=}}"width:750px; margin:0 auto;" |- ! LegacyBreaker2IconIG.png|Legacy '''Breaker2''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Breaker2's''' animation when spawning from a [[Breaker3]] is a reference to [[Mariowiki:Mario|Mario]] from the ''Super Mario Bros'' franchise. *The '''Breaker2''' has the most gamemode appearances, appearing in twelve gamemodes total, alongside the [[Breaker]], [[Breaker3]], and [[Necromancer (Modern Enemy)|Necromancer]]. **[[Breaker4]] formerly appeared in [[Easy Mode|Easy]] mode, but was removed in [[v1.85.0]]. *The functionality of this enemy is very similar to the [[Solar Shard]], [[Lunar Shard]] and [[Dust]] from the [[Solar Eclipse Event]]. **The appearance of this enemy parallels the [[Mystery]], and its first appearance greatly resembles the [[Enemies Beta]] appearance of it. *The [[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] improperly called this enemy a [[Mystery]] in legacy [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode. This was due to the regular mode dialogue being unchanged to account for the [[Enemies Beta]] modifier. **This mistake does not apply to [[Easy Mode|Easy]] mode, since as of [[v1.33.0]], the Commander now properly mentions the '''Breaker2''' in that mode. *There was a bug where units would instantly be destroyed upon collision with a '''Breaker2''', regardless of the unit's or the enemy's health. **This was due to an oversight where the [[Breaker]] spawning from this enemy gained a fraction of a second of invulnerability upon being spawned, instantly killing the unit without taking any damage itself. **Since [[v1.17.0]], units no longer take damage from invulnerable enemies. *The legacy '''Breaker2''', along the [[Breaker]], [[Breaker3]] and [[Breaker4]], will turn into a opaque recolored version of itself when turned into a unit by the [[Hacker]]. *While the Legacy version of the '''Breaker2''' can drop a [[Logbooks|Logbook]], getting it will only give the player the modern
